enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Swift
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: To block this enemy, you need twice as much Block as its Attack value.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Brutal
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: If unblocked, it deals twice as much damage as its Attack value.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Poison
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: If a Unit gets Wounded because of an attack from an enemy with Poison, it is given two Wound cards instead of one. For each Wound a Hero takes into their hand from a Poisonous attack, they also put one Wound into their discard pile.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Paralyze
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: If a Unit gets Wounded because of an attack from an enemy with Paralyze, it is immediately destroyed (removed from the game). If a Hero takes one or more Wounds into their hand from a Paralyzing attack, they must immediately discard any non-Wound cards from their hand.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Assassination
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Damage from this attack cannot be assigned to Units; if unblocked, it has to be all assigned to the hero.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Summon
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: At the start of the Block phase, draw a random enemy token of specified color for this enemy. It replaces the enemy in the Block and Assign Damage phases, then it is discarded.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Fire Attack
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Only Ice and Cold Fire Blocks are efficient when blocking this (others are halved).

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Ice Attack
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Only Fire and Cold Fire Blocks are efficient when blocking this (others are halved).

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Cold Fire Attack
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Only Cold Fire Blocks are efficient when blocking this (others are halved).

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Cumbersome
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: In the Block phase, you may spend Move points; for each Move point spent, the attack is reduced by 1 for the rest of the turn. An attack reduced to 0 is considered successfully blocked.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Vampiric
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: An enemy with the Vampiric ability has its Armor value increased by 1, for the rest of the combat, for each unit its attacks wound and for each wound its attacks cause to be added to a player's hand.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Fortified
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: Only Siege Attacks can be used against this enemy in the Ranged and Siege Attacks phase. If it also defends a fortified site, no attacks at all can be used in that phase.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Physical Resistance
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: All physical Attacks (including cards played sideways) are inefficient (halved).

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Fire Resistance
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: All Fire Attacks are inefficient (halved). The enemy ignores any non-Attack effects of red cards or Unit abilities powered by red mana.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Ice Resistance
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: All Ice Attacks are inefficient (halved). The enemy ignores any non-Attack effects of blue cards or Unit abilities powered by blue mana.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Elusive
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: An elusive enemy has two Armor values (shown as X/Y). The lower value is used only in the Attack phase, and only if all of the enemy attacks are successfully blocked. Any Armor modifications apply to both values.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Unfortified
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: All site fortifications are ignored for such an enemy. Can be attacked normally even when defending fortified sites.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Arcane Immunity
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: The enemy is not affected by any non-Attack/Block effects. Effects that directly affect enemy attacks still apply.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Defend
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: Enemies with the Defend ability will defend themselves or other enemies when you attack them. All attacks in a phase must target enemies with Defend first.

unit_resistances.name: Physical Resistance
unit_resistances.description: Combat with enemies: If the Unit is assigned damage from a physical attack, the damage is reduced by its Armor first (without taking Wounds). If any damage remains, continue as normal. PvP: Opponent must spend twice as much damage to wound that Unit.

unit_resistances.name: Fire Resistance
unit_resistances.description: Combat with enemies: If the Unit is assigned damage from a Fire attack, the damage is reduced by its Armor first (without taking Wounds). Also ignores non-Attack effects of opponent's red cards or Unit abilities powered by red mana.

unit_resistances.name: Ice Resistance
unit_resistances.description: Combat with enemies: If the Unit is assigned damage from an Ice attack, the damage is reduced by its Armor first (without taking Wounds). Also ignores non-Attack effects of opponent's blue cards or Unit abilities powered by blue mana.

attack_types.name: Melee
attack_types.description: Standard attack, can only be used in the Attack phase.

attack_types.name: Ranged
attack_types.description: Can be used in the Ranged and Siege Attack phase. Cannot target Fortified enemies unless the attack is also Siege.

attack_types.name: Siege
attack_types.description: Can be used in the Ranged and Siege Attack phase, even against Fortified enemies. Required to damage Fortified enemies before the Attack phase.

block_efficiency.description: When blocking an elemental attack with a non-matching block type, the block value is halved (rounded down).
